csv_project_name: OPM for Emergency Communications Center Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: Owners Project Manager services for 5,500 square foot renovation to the third floor of the Pepperell Public Safety Building, including adding an elevator, for the use of Patriot RECC. The duties of the OPM shall include, but need not be limited to, providing advice and consultation to, with respect to design, value engineering, scope of the work, cost estimating, general contractor and subcontractor prequalification pursuant to section 44D of 44D when applicable, scheduling, construction and the selection, negotiation with and oversight of a designer and a general contractor for the project, ensuring the time schedules which shall serve as control standards for monitoring performance of the building project, and assisting in project evaluation including, but not limited to, written evaluation of the performance of the design professional, contractors, and subcontractors.
csv_disciplines_requested: Interior Design/Space Planning, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Value Engineering
